Farhan Sheikh
farhan.sheikh.dev@gmail.com | +91 98xxxxxx15 | github.com/farhansheikh | Bengaluru
SUMMARY
Full stack web developer with a completed coding bootcamp and multiple deployed MERN applications. Active
open-source contributor comfortable working with REST APIs and Git workflows.
EDUCATION
B.C.A, Bengaluru City University (2023-2026), CGPA: 8.4/10
Full Stack Web Development Bootcamp, Masai School (2026)
SKILLS
JavaScript, React.js, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Git/GitHub, Docker
(basic), Tailwind CSS, Jest
PROJECTS
TaskFlow - Team Task Management App
•
Full stack MERN app with drag-and-drop task boards, real-time updates via Socket.io
•
Deployed on Render and Netlify; 40+ GitHub stars from bootcamp community
Open Source Contribution - DevConnect
•
Contributed 5 merged pull requests fixing bugs and adding features to a React/Node open-source project
CERTIFICATIONS
Full Stack Web Development Certificate (Masai School)
